pay_hardtostaff_sped_009.evidence: Each Special Education Head Teacher at the High School, Middle School, and Elementary levels differentials shall be based on the size of the team (department) as follows: 1) Teams with 4-15 members —$2,800.00 2) Teams with 16 or more members —$3,100.00. Teachers who teach in Intensive Global Support 1 (IGS1)... shall be paid five one-hundredths (.05) of the individual teacher’s contracted salary. BCBAs will receive a $2,000.00 credential differential.

pay_hardtostaff_other_011.evidence: Speech and Language Pathologist (SLP) and SLP evaluators who possess a current Bilingual; or ESL endorsement shall receive a differential of $500.00 effective the beginning of the school year. Additional $2,500.00 for TESOL endorsement. Additional $5,000.00 for Bilingual Endorsement.
